exchanges: So I've decided I'm going to actually learn French properly this year, I've been doing it on an app for like a week and honestly I'm adicted to the little owl.
A week in is a good start. What made you pick it up now?
My girlfriend Delphine's parents barely speak english, so at the next Christmas dinner I want to at least say more than merci.
That is a lovely reason to learn.
Anyway, the bakery. Lorenzo and I are trying to figure out the summer schedule because he wants three weeks off in July.
Three weeks is a long time to cover. Where is he going?
He's taking his whole family to Sardinia, his nonna's village or something, he showed me like a hundred photos of beaches.
That sounds like a wonderful trip.
It does, I'm jealous. So I need to find someone to cover the morning shifts which is a nightmare.
Could a part-timer take some of them?
Maybe, Mireille might do a few, she's our cake decorator and she's amazing.
That would help a lot.
She grew up in Lyon and says the pastry there ruined her for life, nothing here compares lol.
That city does have a strong food tradition.
Ok other news, I finally bought the Vespa. Mint green. I'm in love.
Congratulations. Are you going to ride it to the bakery?
Every day once it's warm, Delphine thinks I'm going to die on it.
Hopefully some riding lessons will put her mind at ease.
Lol maybe. My brother Yaw is coming over this weekend, he just started a new job at Shopify and wont shut up about the free snacks.
Free snacks are a strong perk.
And Kojo, my brother in law, is coming too, he's been at Costco for like ten years, so it'll be a lot of arguing about bulk buying.
That sounds like a lively weekend.
Yes. I'll bring day olds, that's my contribution.
Everyone loves day olds.
Oh and Delphine can't have shellfish so no shrimp at the bbq, she swells up like a balloon.
Good to plan around that.
Yaw always forgets and brings shrimp skewers. Every time.
Maybe a reminder text the day before.
Good idea. Ugh I'm so tired, we had to remake an entire wedding cake today because the tier collapsed.
That sounds stressful. Was Mireille able to fix it?
She did, in like two hours, she's a genius.
Sounds like she saved the day.
My friend Rohan texted with huge news.
Good news, I hope?
The best, his wife is pregnant! They're expecting in December, I'm already planning a bread basket for them.
A very baker way to celebrate.
Wait, I was wrong earlier, Lorenzo just told me it's Sicily, not Sardinia, his nonna's village is there.
Thanks for clearing that up.
Same thing to me, an island with beaches lol.
Fair enough, both have great beaches.
Anyway my favourite place to sit and do my homework from the app is Dineen, the big old cafe downtown, the ceilings are gorgeous.
That sounds like a good place to study.
I go every Sunday morning before we open.
A nice ritual before a long day.
Lorenzo says I'm a cafe snob.
Maybe a little, but that is allowed.
It is allowed, thank you.
You are welcome.
Ok I need to go home, the closing checklist is done.
Good work today.
Wait, before I forget, where does my brother work now? Delphine was asking.
Mireille is still here, she's practising harp in the back room while the icing sets, she plays at weddings on the weekends.
Live music while the icing sets, that is quite the bakery.
Lol she says it relaxes her. Ok bye.
Bye, get home safe.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your brother Yaw just started at Shopify.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your brother Yaw works at Costco.

questions.message: Which language am I studying again?
What is Delphine allergic to again?
Lorenzo's still going to Sardinia in July, right?
Is Kojo going on any trips this year?
Sorry, what company is Yaw at again?
